briefdescription.para: This function validates the FIPS 205 context length field.

inbodydescription.para: FIPS 205 encodes the context length in a single byte, so any value above XASU_SLHDSA_MAX_CTX_LEN cannot be represented in the signed message prefix. CtxLen zero is valid and selects the empty context.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the required pre-hash HashId for a parameter set.

detaileddescription.para: FIPS 205 footnote 18: PH(M) must be at least 2n bytes. 128s sets (n = 16) use SHA-256; 256s sets (n = 32) use SHA-512.

simplesect.para: XASU_SLHDSA_HASHID_SHA256 or XASU_SLHDSA_HASHID_SHA512, or XASU_SLHDSA_HASHID_INVALID if ParamSet is unsupported.

inbodydescription.para: 256s sets require SHA-512 (n = 32); 128s sets require SHA-256 (n = 16). An unsupported ParamSet returns XASU_SLHDSA_HASHID_INVALID.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the SLH-DSA parameter set selector.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if ParamSet is a supported value (0..3).
XST_INVALID_PARAM, if ParamSet is out of range.

inbodydescription.para: The supported parameter sets are numbered contiguously with XASU_SLHDSA_PARAM_SHA2_128S as the highest value, so a single upper-bound check rejects every unsupported selector.

briefdescription.para: This function validates that CtxAddr is provided when a non-empty context is specified.

parameterdescription.para: DMA address of context bytes (required when CtxLen is 1..255).
Context length field from sign or verify parameters.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if CtxAddr is valid for the given CtxLen.
XST_INVALID_PARAM, if CtxLen is 1..255 and CtxAddr is zero.

inbodydescription.para: A non-zero context length promises context bytes to hash, so the address must be present. The reverse case is allowed: a non-zero address with CtxLen zero is simply ignored and treated as the empty context.

memberdef.name: XAsu_SlhdsaValidatePreHashFields

briefdescription.para: This function validates HashSLH-DSA pre-hash fields on sign/verify parameters.

parameterdescription.para: Message or PH(M) digest length in bytes.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if pre-hash fields are valid.

inbodydescription.para: Accept only the two defined message modes.
Pure SLH-DSA hashes the message itself, so HashId is unused and MsgLen is already bounded by the caller. Nothing further to check.
HashSLH-DSA fixes the pre-hash function per parameter set, so that PH(M) is at least 2n bytes (FIPS 205 footnote 18). A caller supplied HashId that disagrees is rejected instead of being overridden.
A zero digest length means HashId is not a supported pre-hash function.
In pre-hash mode the caller passes PH(M) rather than the message, so MsgLen must be exactly the digest length of the selected pre-hash function.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the SLH-DSA sign mode field.

inbodydescription.para: Accept only the two defined modes. Any other value is rejected rather than being silently treated as hedged, so a corrupted field cannot quietly change how the signature randomizer is derived.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the public key size in bytes for the given SLH-DSA parameter set.

simplesect.para: Public key size in bytes (32 for 128s sets, 64 for 256s sets), or 0 if ParamSet is unsupported.

inbodydescription.para: Public key size is 2n bytes: 64 for 256s sets and 32 for 128s sets. Unsupported ParamSet values return 0.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the secret key size in bytes for the given SLH-DSA parameter set.

simplesect.para: Secret key size in bytes (64 for 128s sets, 128 for 256s sets), or 0 if ParamSet is unsupported.

inbodydescription.para: Secret key size is 4n bytes: 128 for 256s sets and 64 for 128s sets. Unsupported ParamSet values return 0.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the signature size in bytes for the given SLH-DSA parameter set.

simplesect.para: Signature size in bytes (7856 for 128s sets, 29792 for 256s sets), or 0 if ParamSet is unsupported.

inbodydescription.para: Signature length is fixed per parameter set (FIPS 205 Table 2). SHAKE and SHA2 share the same sizes for a given security level; unsupported selectors return 0.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the PH(M) digest length for a pre-hash HashId.

simplesect.para: Digest length in bytes (32 for SHA-256, 64 for SHA-512), or 0 if unsupported.

inbodydescription.para: Map HashId to PH(M) length: 32 bytes for SHA-256, 64 bytes for SHA-512. An unsupported HashId returns 0.

briefdescription.para: This function validates SLH-DSA sign parameters.

listitem.para: XST_INVALID_PARAM, if any field is invalid (NULL pointer, zero addresses, invalid ParamSet, CtxLen/CtxAddr mismatch, MsgLen exceeds DMA limit, SignatureLen mismatch, or SkLen not equal to the ParamSet secret-key size).

inbodydescription.para: Validate input pointer.
Validate the parameter set first, since the expected signature size and the required pre-hash function are both derived from it.
Validate the context length against the FIPS 205 limit of 255 bytes.
Validate that a context address is supplied whenever a non-empty context is used.
Bound the message length by what the ASU DMA can transfer in a single operation, as the message is fed to the hash engine without being split.
The secret key, message and signature addresses are all mandatory, so a zero address in any of them is rejected before ASUFW dereferences it.
The secret key is a fixed length per parameter set, so SkLen must match exactly. A caller declaring any other length has not supplied the whole key.
SLH-DSA signatures are a fixed length per parameter set, so SignatureLen must match exactly. This is what guarantees the output buffer is large enough to be written.
Validate the pure versus pre-hash message mode, and in pre-hash mode that HashId is the one required by the parameter set and MsgLen is the matching digest length.
Validate the sign mode, which selects hedged or deterministic signing.

briefdescription.para: This function validates SLH-DSA signature verification parameters.

listitem.para: XST_INVALID_PARAM, if any field is invalid (NULL pointer, zero addresses, invalid ParamSet, CtxLen/CtxAddr mismatch, MsgLen exceeds DMA limit, SignatureLen mismatch, or PubKeyLen not equal to the ParamSet public key size).

inbodydescription.para: Validate input pointer.
Validate the parameter set, which fixes the expected signature and public key sizes.
Validate the context length against the FIPS 205 limit of 255 bytes.

Validate that a context address is supplied whenever a non-empty context is used. Both CtxLen and CtxAddr must reproduce the values used at signing time, because the context is bound into the message digest.
Bound the message length by the maximum single ASU DMA transfer length.
The public key, message and signature addresses are all mandatory for verification.
Reject a signature whose length does not match the parameter set, so that a truncated or oversized signature is never parsed as if it were well formed.
The public key is a fixed length per parameter set, so PubKeyLen must match exactly. Verification always reads the whole key, so a shorter declared length would leave part of it unvalidated.
Validate the message mode and, for pre-hash mode, the HashId and digest length.
